sentences.text: The current loan agreement lists a ₹500 documentation fee payable at execution, while the KFS lists only a ₹400 processing fee as a one-time charge, so the two documents do not match on that fee.
For a UCB, fees and charges not mentioned in the KFS cannot be charged at any stage during the term of the loan without the borrower’s explicit consent.
Whether that restriction applies here is not fully answered because the rule finding says applicability is unknown and needs the sanction date.

missing.searched: Checked the UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions applicability note for para 256(5); it says sanction date is needed, but no sanction date was provided in the case facts or evidence.
